description_en: Queries the daily user region distribution statistics for accelerated domain names. You can query data of the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRegionData获取加速域名天粒度的用户区域分布数据统计，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDomainRegionData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, all accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval of each record. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the queried data. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
EndTime.description_zh: 获取数据结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the queried data. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
StartTime.description_zh: 获取数据起始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

RegionProportionData.description_en: The list of access proportion data for each region
RegionProportionData.description_zh: 各地域访问占比数据列表

AvgObjectSize.description_en: The average response size. Unit: bytes

AvgResponseRate.description_en: The average response speed. Unit: Bps

AvgResponseTime.description_en: The average response time. Unit: milliseconds
AvgResponseTime.description_zh: 平均响应时间，单位：毫秒

BytesProportion.description_en: The total traffic proportion. For example, a value of 90 indicates 90%
BytesProportion.description_zh: 总流量占比，例如返回90即为90%

Proportion.description_en: The access proportion. For example, a value of 90 indicates 90%
Proportion.description_zh: 访问占比数据，例如返回90即为90%

RegionEname.description_en: The English name of the region

ReqErrRate.description_en: The request error rate. For example, a value of 90 indicates 90%
ReqErrRate.description_zh: 请求错误率，例如返回90即为90%
